scope: Blinded catalogue access and quality audit only. No formula evaluated, no acceleration/model residual computed, no samples selected by agreement. Only the two explicitly authorized small catalogues downloaded; 236-MB model archive and 4-GB image partitions untouched.

join.warning: MER_object_id is missing after some positional refinements; do not use it as the primary join. sed_fitting_id is a processing identifier rather than the stable cross-product lens key.

funnel.expression: final_sample == True (all seven D cuts, including DET_QUALITY_FLAG<4)
finite and positive surviving stellar mass and four listed light metadata fields; missing sentinel -99 rejected
finite desi_deflector_specz > 0 (vetted by Storfer et al. according to README)

both_specz_gold_sample.status: Not determinable from inspected catalogue products; do not report as either 39 or zero. The source-redshift column and source-redshift linkage are absent.
both_specz_gold_sample.meaning_of_zero: Zero rows with an available source-redshift field in these files; this does not mean zero physical systems with known source redshifts.
both_specz_gold_sample.reason_upper_bound: Only 12 grade-A pairs are reported before the independent model/stellar-quality cuts. Their intersection with the 39 clean lens-redshift candidates cannot be determined without their identifiers.

independently_named_paper_pilot.name: PS1J1821+7130
independently_named_paper_pilot.paper_table: Bergamini et al., Table1 p.4 and DESI confirmation Sect.5 pp.6–7, https://pubs.euclid-ec.org/public/dr1/bergamini.pdf
independently_named_paper_pilot.interpretation: Concrete source-redshift-known feasibility target, but not a clean gold target under the quality cuts specified for this metadata audit before any formula scoring. Do not waive DET_QUALITY_FLAG386 after seeing outcomes. Resolve its detection flags/re-extract photometry before any fixed-normalization test.

unavailable_fields_and_products: No source spectroscopic-redshift values, source-redshift errors, source spectroscopic IDs or source/lens pair flag in object CSV, key CSV or full D FITS.
No observed stellar velocity dispersion or rotation curve in these catalogues. Any SIE-converted velocity scale is model-derived, not independent dynamics.

The small tables contain global stellar mass, luminosity, mass-to-light and Sersic radius/index summaries, not image-plane light, PSF, masks, noise, full light-axis-ratio/position-angle models or pixel source reconstructions.

Individual model images/PSFs/noise/masks need a later targeted public-data retrieval; archive metadata supplies per-lens partition manifest through the larger model release. No such large products were downloaded.
No gas mass/map, independent stellar mass-to-light calibration, line-of-sight convergence or calibrated lens-parameter covariance.

quality_definitions.lens_model_success: True iff lens_model_consensus_75 is Success; No Consensus and N/A do not qualify for this strict audit.
quality_definitions.D_final_sample: All seven published cuts. cut_ii_lens_model alone permits Success, No Consensus and N/A; it is insufficient for a clean sample.
quality_definitions.flag_unreliable: Prospector ppc p-value<0.01, a band residual>5 sigma, ESS<200, or no fit.
quality_definitions.stellar_mass_column: eclipse_log_survived_mass_med (log10 solar masses, surviving stars plus remnants); eclipse_logmass is total formed mass and must not substitute.
quality_definitions.error_conventions: Prospector *_low/*_upp are asymmetric errors; lens-model *_lower_1_sigma/*_upper_1_sigma are bounds, not errors.

paper_release_convention_conflicts: D README says SED fits fix redshift to Phosphoros photo-z; paper Sect.4.2 p.7 says use spectroscopic redshift when available. No spec-z-used field exists, so stellar masses should be refitted at verified lens redshifts for a precision lens test.

D archive includes formal lens-model 1-sigma bounds; C paper p.12 explicitly defers calibration of individual parameter uncertainties and systematic errors. These are not validated total-error budgets.

D README calls eclipse_effective_radius non-circularized; D paper Sect.3.1 p.5 calls the reported effective radius circularized sqrt(a*b). Resolve definitions from model files before deprojection or aperture-mass calculations.
next_exact_join_required: Obtain row-level vetted source redshifts (Storfer et al. companion data or original vetted DESI target IDs/sky coordinates), with errors, line identification and a deflector/source distinction.

Join using EUCL-DR1-L identifiers if provided; otherwise perform a documented position match to RA_obj/DEC_obj with explicit angular separations and ambiguity checks. Do not join by rounded names alone.
Intersect source-redshift-known rows with the 39-object quality-audit list; require z_source>z_lens and propagate redshift errors. This defines the gold-sample size; no agreement-based selection.

Retrieve only targeted image/PSF/noise/mask/light products for those systems and independently model stellar baryons at spectroscopic lens redshift before testing a preselected relativistic completion with fixed normalization.
selection_provenance: No separately persisted pre-inspection freeze or preregistration was created. Quality cuts were specified while inspecting catalogue schemas and published quality definitions, then counted without evaluating any formula or acceleration/model-agreement residual. This is a retrospective metadata feasibility audit, not a sealed prospective experiment.
